title: デビュー戦の後に・黎明

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Huff, puff, huff…

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: …Nailed it!

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text: Whoa, that was some slick running from Satono Diamond! No wonder she got such a high evaluation score!

text_block_list.name: Fan B
text_block_list.text: She was so calm and relaxed, you wouldn't think this was her debut race! She's definitely got a bright future ahead of her!

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text: I hope she can win a G1 race and break the Satono jinx!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: I've finally made my debut!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: It only started to sink in once I'd finished running.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: The audience's cheering, the pressure from the other racers and the sound of their breathing, the taut sense of tension in the air…

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: I'd never felt such an atmosphere before. So this is what a real race is like!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: This is the kind of atmosphere both McQueen and Kita have been running in…

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: And now, I'm finally standing on the same turf as them!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Satono Diamond's excitement is palpable, evidence of just how deeply moving her debut must have been.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: I'm going to keep running and winning with these two legs of mine, and make the Satono family's wish into a reality!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: We join the stream of people leaving the venue after the races and head toward the station.

text_block_list.name: Fan C
text_block_list.text: Satono Diamond ran so beautifully! You know, the one who ran in the 500-Million-Point Battle?

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text: That dash of hers in the final stretch was out of this world for sure!

text_block_list.name: Fan C
text_block_list.text: I bet it won't be long before she's running in G1 races. I wouldn't be surprised if she aims for the Japanese Derby!

text_block_list.name: Fan B
text_block_list.text: Hm? Come to think of it, have any of the Umamusume from the Satono Group ever won a G1 race?

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text: Not yet. Plenty of Satono Umamusume have raced before, but none of them ever managed to secure a G1 victory.

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text: That's why you'll sometimes see articles in magazines with headlines like "The Satono Jinx: The Family Cursed with No G1 Wins."

text_block_list.name: Fan C
text_block_list.text: Huh, I didn't know that was a thing. So it's like they can't win a G1 race because of a jinx?

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text: Yeah. There weren't any Satono Umamusume at all for a while till Satono Diamond came along. It'd be nice if she can nab a G1 victory.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: While listening to the conversation between the people walking in front of us, I glance over at Satono Diamond.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Hehe! And I'm going to be the one to break the jinx!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Satono Diamond grins cheerfully and strikes a confident pose.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: With her unwavering confidence and strength, I'm sure she'll be able to dispel both the unpleasant rumors and the jinx in one fell swoop.
